cases.prompt: Complete the people filter page. Typing in Search people should immediately filter names, ignoring surrounding spaces and letter case. With no matches, show an announced empty state. Escape should clear the search and restore all people while keeping focus in the search field. Make the page usable at a 390px viewport without horizontal scrolling, while preserving the existing people and simple visual style. Hand off the change and its validation.
cases.projectGuidance: This static page has no build step or external dependencies. Keep filtering logic in people.cjs and the page in index.html. Required checks are `unit` and `browser`. Keep the Search people accessible name and the existing person names.
